root_cause: The page browser check used the canonical production build in RUNNER_TEMP/site, but the SEO/internal-link check still executed in the raw repository workspace. Canonical shell projection therefore appeared as broad menu/footer drift even while the exact-head production build and live-readback were green.
prevention_rule: Pagina- en SEO-controle must run browser and SEO strategy checks against the same canonical production-projected site tree. Raw-source shell differences may never be promoted to production SEO defects.
